en: A colorized vintage postcard view over a riverside town with red-roofed houses along a broad river, surrounded by hills. In the foreground and to the right stand prominent church buildings with towers. On a hill to the left sits a striking neo-Gothic church overlooking the river. At the top center of the image is the caption text in German: "Remagen mit Apollinariskirche." The overall print and wear suggest an early 20th‑century chromolithographic postcard.
